items.title: Julian Sayin injury: Ohio State QB leaves game vs. Indiana
items.summary: Update: Ohio State head coach Ryan Day said after the win over Indiana that Julian Sayin will be out “several weeks.” Following a bye week in Week 8, Ohio State plays USC, Oregon, Northwestern…
